name: YITAMOTOR 48.7" Adjustable Disc Bedder, Heavy Duty Garden Disc Plow Compatible for Category 1, 3 Point Quick Hitch for Tractor
fitment: 3 POINT QUICK HITCH COMPATIBLE: The Category 1, 3 point disc bedder seamlessly integrates with tractor quick hitches.
warnings: 官网质保弹窗引用其他品牌
description:
Experience the versatility of the YITAMOTOR disc bedder with an impressive maximum working width of up to 48.7 inches, so there’s ample space to create raised garden beds and nurture a variety of vibrant vegetable gardens
Fitment
3 POINT QUICK HITCH COMPATIBLE: The Category 1, 3 point disc bedder seamlessly integrates with tractor quick hitches.
Features
48.7 INCH WORKING WIDTH: Experience the versatility of the YITAMOTOR disc bedder with an impressive maximum working width of up to 48.7 inches, so there’s ample space to create raised garden beds and nurture a variety of vibrant vegetable gardens
ADJUSTABLE DEPTH, WIDTH AND ANGLE: Our ingeniously designed adjustable disc plow empowers you to effortlessly customize the working depth (0-15.2"), width (0-48.7") and angle of the precision disc blades, so you always have the perfect cultivation setup for your unique gardening needs
3 POINT QUICK HITCH COMPATIBLE: The Category 1, 3 point disc bedder seamlessly integrates with tractor quick hitches. You can complete a quick installation in minutes
HEAVY DUTY STEEL CONSTRUCTION: Crafted from top-quality heavy-duty steel, this robust disc bedder is durable and built to last; The professionally thickened dual discs promote long-lasting durability, while the sleek black powder coated finish adds a touch of elegance and offers excellent rust resistance regardless of weather condition
DIMENSIONS: The disc bedder features an impressive overall width of 48.7 inches and overall height of 38 inches; The sturdy disc blades boast a sizable diameter of 16 inches, while the total weight of 112.4 lbs ensures stability and reliability
